editorial:
Imagine being a huge star who suddenly loses everything, only to find a lifeline in a rich, mysterious wellness guru. That is exactly what happens to Samantha Lake. You will feel her desperation as she tries to get her life back, but things get weird fast. The movie starts off looking like a shiny, high-end drama about health and beauty, but it quickly turns into a creepy thriller. You get the feeling that something is very wrong with Zoe Shannon and her perfect world, and the tension builds up in a way that makes you lean in closer to the screen.

The acting is top-notch and makes the scary parts feel real. While the middle part slows down a bit, the big twists at the end make up for it. If you love stories about fake people and hidden secrets, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call because the visuals are stunning.
endingExplained: You find out that Zoe Shannon is not actually human, but a creature that steals the youth and beauty of others to stay young. In the final scenes, Samantha discovers she was only brought in to be the next victim. She manages to fight back during a scary ritual and escapes the compound just as it burns down. The movie ends with her finally free, though she is scarred by the experience.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about creepy cults.
